brief:
An opinion piece in Middle East Eye argues that Hamas's October 7 attack cannot be separated from the historical context of Palestinian dispossession, occupation, and siege. The analysis suggests the organization viewed the status quo as presenting greater danger than the risks of military action.

The piece frames the assault within decades of Palestinian experience under Israeli control, positioning the operation as a response to conditions the group deemed unsustainable.
dek: Opinion: Why Hamas believed the status quo was more dangerous than its 7 October gamble The events of 7 October cannot be understood outside the long history of Palestinian dispossession, occupation, siege and struggle.
title: Analyst examines Hamas calculations before October 7 attack
